name: יָעוֹר
summary: Chronicles gives the written name יָעוֹר and the reading יָעִיר for the father of Elhanan. The reading resembles the verb “he rouses” in the song of Moses. Samuel gives the father’s name as Jaare-oregim.

evidence.note: עֵר describes the heart as awake, giving the lexical comparison.

note: The proposed sense follows the form of the name. The naming passage gives no explanation.
